newsitem.title: THAILAND: Precious Shipping to buy two vessels.
newsitem.headline: Precious Shipping to buy two vessels.

text.p: Precious Shipping Plc, Thailand's major shipping firm, said on Thursday that it had signed agreements to buy two used vessels at a total cost of $20.85 million.
The company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that both vessels were bulk carriers and built in Japan.
The first vessel has a capacity of 23,724 deadweight tonnes (dwt) while the second one has a capacity of 21,259 dwt. The vessels will be delivered next month and in August, it said.
Precious Shipping said it bought the vessels to accommodate expanding business.
Precious Shipping shares were trading at 54 baht per share at 0737 GMT on Thursday, unchanged from Wednesday.
